title: Spectral Properties of Dense Barabási-Albert Graphs
summary: Preferential attachment graphs model networks whose growth produces highly uneven degree distributions, describing many real-world systems. Their adjacency spectra are important because they allow graph-theoretic questions to be studied through the eigenvalues of matrices. We analyze the adjacency matrix of a dense Barabási-Albert (B-A) multigraph, where the number of edges added at each step is proportional to the final number of vertices.
